intro: Kebun Baru Ridge is an HDB BTO project in Ang Mo Kio. HDB launched it on 16 June 2026, and our project file records 485 flats. That official confirmation covers the launch date and the unit count as recorded; it does not confirm TOP or key collection. Our file notes that completion and keys are unconfirmed and generally beyond 2027. Tenure is left blank. Your HDB financial and flat-selection documents remain the source of truth for typologies, storey and stack. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Kebun Baru Ridge renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Kebun Baru Ridge interior
sections.text:
A 485-flat project is large enough that unit types will vary, and we will not guess them. When HDB issues your approved floor plan, that is the moment to start a serious interior brief: where the kitchen run sits, whether a common bedroom should take a built-in desk, and how much entry storage the household actually needs. Maison designs those pieces as built-in carpentry — fitted kitchen cabinets, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall — not as loose, flat-pack furniture. We photograph the work the way a professional interior is finished, including closer material shots when you need to decide on a finish.

Kebun Baru Breeze was launched in the same June 2026 exercise and is the natural nearby page on this site. Do not assume the two projects share a typologies list or a completion date. Ang Mo Kio is a mature town; AMO Residence is already live in the wider District 20 belt. Those are internal links, not a claim about walking times or facilities from your future block.

Because keys are generally still some years off, the useful work now is patience and paperwork, not demolition. Keep your official plan when it is issued, and write to us when you want the carpentry drawings frozen well before any permit. After keys, inspect defects, then apply for the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your unit type and plan when you have them. We are not affiliated with HDB.

faq.q: When was Kebun Baru Ridge launched?
faq.a: Our project file records: 2026-06-16 launch. That official confirmation covers the launch date only, not TOP or key collection.

faq.q: Is the key-collection date for Kebun Baru Ridge confirmed?
faq.a: No. Completion and keys are unconfirmed in our file. Use your HDB documents for your own appointment, when you have one.

faq.q: Do you have the Kebun Baru Ridge floor plan?
faq.a: No official floor-plan or site image is on file for this page, so none is published here. Please send your approved HDB unit plan.

Your approved floor plan, unit type if you have it, and a key date if one is already in writing. After keys, an HDB renovation permit is required before works. WhatsApp us at https://wa.me/6593391185.
